clover.label: 🟡 제한적 혼합급여 근거 · 검증 중
clover.support: Mediterranean tortoise specialist guidance includes clover among forage candidates.
clover.restriction: Existing project evidence flags moderation because clover can be comparatively protein-rich; no exact percentage is assigned.
clover.identity: Trifolium species must be preserved rather than treating every clover as identical.

alfalfa.label: 🟡 섭식·사육 근거 있음 · 검증 중
alfalfa.support: T. graeca field literature and project evidence include Medicago taxa; alfalfa-specific captive use still requires scope control.
alfalfa.restriction: Medicago species evidence must not be collapsed automatically into M. sativa feeding rules.
alfalfa.identity: Medicago sativa identity required for an alfalfa nutrient record.

endive.label: 🟡 일반 잎채소 근거 · 검증 중
endive.support: Existing project husbandry layer supports endive only at general/supplement evidence level.
endive.restriction: General leafy-vegetable guidance is not species-specific evidence.
endive.identity: Retail endive type/cultivar and preparation must match nutrient record.

romaine.label: 🟡 제한적 보조식 근거 · 검증 중
romaine.support: Existing specialist guidance in the project supports romaine only in very limited quantities.
romaine.restriction: Do not promote romaine to staple merely because it is widely available.
romaine.identity: Lactuca sativa var. longifolia/cos-romaine record must match retail item.

mulberry.label: 🟡 식물동정·근거 검증 중
mulberry.support: Mulberry leaf is a common keeper question, but the current database does not yet have enough scoped evidence for a green verdict.
mulberry.restriction: Morus species/cultivar identity and leaf composition cannot be generalized without review.
mulberry.identity: Exact Morus species/cultivar required where possible.
